title: Find customers with no email
prompt: Return the first_name and last_name of every customer who has no email. The starter returns no rows.
hints: What does a comparison with NULL give?
There is a special test for a missing value, and it does not use =.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Looks for empty text, which is a different thing from a missing value.
Returns the customers who do have an email.

feedback: Count your rows. Three customers have no email, and only IS NULL finds them.
